registry_note: The registry no longer lists this server (last checked 2026-11-23). This page is kept because its URL is public; the scores below are from the last scan taken while the server was listed, on 2026-10-11, and have not been recomputed, because there is no current entry to scan.

evidence.label: mcp-python-path-join-unvalidated (medium/low)
evidence.detail: A filesystem path is assembled from a value that is not a literal and opened without confinement. os.path.join discards the base entirely when the second component is absolute, and neither join nor `/` resolves `..`.

evidence.label: authentication_model
evidence.detail: credential requirement present; enforcement partially evidenced

evidence.label: transport_security
evidence.detail: declared endpoint(s) are HTTPS: https://api.limitguard.ai/mcp; scored 80, not 100: `03` §4 reserves 100 for HTTPS *with HSTS*, and an HSTS header can only be seen by connecting, which `04` §9 does not do. This is an unverifiable band, not an observed absence.

evidence.label: secret_handling
evidence.detail: detect-secrets matched 1 credential-shaped string(s), every one from a keyword or entropy heuristic (Hex High Entropy String). Those flag placeholders, variable names and content hashes as readily as credentials, so they do not establish the committed credential `03` §4's 0 asserts, and this sub-check is not scored; Hex High Entropy String at .github/workflows/release.yml:44

evidence.label: authorization_granularity
evidence.detail: 10 tool registrations and no conditional access logic found — `03` §4 calls this case 'needs human review' and assigns it no score band, so it is not scored here

evidence.label: issue_responsiveness
evidence.detail: lifetime median (2 issue(s) in the last 6 months, under `03` §5's floor of 3): 15.1 day(s) to first maintainer comment

evidence.label: release_cadence
evidence.detail: released 2 day(s) ago (by releases), inside `03` §5's 30-day window

evidence.label: repository_signals
evidence.detail: `03` §5 scores this by quartile WITHIN the server's category, which needs a distribution across every scanned server and so cannot be computed while scanning one. It is a post-pass over the crawl and that pass does not exist yet.

dependency_health.reason: no lockfile in the fetched source; dependency versions are unresolved, so no vulnerability can be attributed

evidence.label: license
evidence.detail: LICENSE present with no SPDX-License-Identifier tag; identified as 'MIT' from its text

evidence.label: readme_quality
evidence.detail: README.md: installation instructions (+25), configuration documented (+25), exposed tools or resources enumerated (+30), states what the server does in the first 200 words (+20)

evidence.label: declared_scopes
evidence.detail: specific scope or access documentation is present, but `03` §7's 100 and 60 bands both compare it against scopes INFERRED from static analysis, which is not built yet. Scoring 100 on an empty inference would be a vacuous truth — 'all ∅ inferred scopes are documented'.

evidence.label: security_contact
evidence.detail: no SECURITY.md and no disclosure contact in the README, so a finder has no route to report a vulnerability privately
